verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents control mapping to framework requirements for each supported framework, with automated control testing feeding evidence (docs-60). It also automatically maps existing controls to CMMC requirements to find gaps (docs-73), and it supports SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and others (docs-40, 42, 43). This implies controls can be mapped to several frameworks, but nothing explicitly says SOC 2 work carries over to ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or that overlap is shown. Missing for 10: explicit cross-framework control/evidence reuse (SOC 2 → ISO 27001/HIPAA), a documented overlap or crosswalk view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
